videos.title: Beginner Indoor Walk
videos.description: A gentle 15-minute walk at home, led step by step. No equipment and no jumping. Go at your own pace.

exercises.name: Warm-up: Gentle March
exercises.easier: Keep your feet low, or hold a chair back for balance.

exercises.name: Warm-up: March + Arm Swings
exercises.easier: Keep the arms low if your shoulders feel stiff.

exercises.name: March on the Spot
exercises.easier: Slow it down any time, small steps still count.

exercises.name: Side Steps
exercises.easier: Make the steps smaller, or tap the foot out instead of stepping.

exercises.name: Knee Lifts
exercises.easier: Lift the knee only as high as feels comfortable, or hold a chair.

exercises.name: Step Touch
exercises.easier: Keep it slow and small.

exercises.name: March + Arm Swings
exercises.easier: Keep the arms at chest height.

exercises.name: March on the Spot (Round 2)
exercises.easier: Easy pace is fine.

exercises.name: Side Steps (Round 2)
exercises.easier: Small steps.

exercises.name: Step Touch (Round 2)
exercises.easier: Slow it right down if you need to.

exercises.name: Knee Lifts (Round 2)
exercises.easier: Marching is a great alternative.

videos.title: Seated Chair Workout
videos.description: A gentle 10-minute workout done fully seated. Great for low-energy days, joint pain or getting started.

exercises.name: Warm-up: Seated March
exercises.easier: Just lift the heels if lifting the foot is too much.

exercises.name: Warm-up: Arm Raises
exercises.easier: Raise to shoulder height only.

exercises.name: Seated March
exercises.easier: Slow it down and keep the arms still if you prefer.

exercises.name: Arm Raises
exercises.easier: One arm at a time.

exercises.name: Torso Twists
exercises.easier: Make the twist smaller. Skip if you have back pain.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Extensions
exercises.easier: Only straighten part way.

exercises.name: Seated March (Faster)
exercises.easier: Stay at your own pace.

exercises.name: Torso Twists (Round 2)
exercises.easier: Smaller twist.

exercises.name: Leg Extensions (Round 2)
exercises.easier: Part way is perfect.

videos.title: Full-Body Bodyweight
videos.description: A 15-minute full-body bodyweight workout with no equipment: squats, lunges, push-ups, planks and core moves, with an easier option for every exercise. Warm up first with a separate warm-up.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
exercises.easier: Only go halfway down, or hold a chair for balance.

exercises.name: Knee Push-ups
exercises.easier: Do them against a wall instead.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunges
exercises.easier: Make the step shorter and only dip a little, or hold a wall.

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
exercises.easier: Lift only a little way, or pause at the top for a breath.

exercises.name: Standing Knee Drives
exercises.easier: March instead, with lower knees.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.easier: Drop your knees to the floor, or hold for shorter bursts.

exercises.name: Squat to Calf Raise
exercises.easier: Skip the calf raise, or keep a hand on the wall.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.easier: Knees down, or use the wall.

exercises.name: Side Lunges
exercises.easier: Make the step smaller and only bend a little.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.easier: Move just the arms, or just the legs.

exercises.name: Standing Cross Crunches
exercises.easier: Lift the knee lower and go slower.

exercises.name: Sumo Squats
exercises.easier: Narrow the stance and only go halfway.

exercises.name: Low-Impact Skaters
exercises.easier: Make it a side step touch.

coach-ava.name: Coach Ava
coach-ava.label: AI-generated instructor
coach-ava.bio: Coach Ava is an AI-generated guide created by GLP1 Life. She isn't a real person and has no fitness qualifications. Every class she leads was checked by a person before it was published.
